title: [master]-[BE] [PEPPOL] There is a problem between the totals on the invoice printout and the XML PEPPOL with Payment discount
summary: Fixed discrepancy between invoice printout and PEPPOL XML totals in Belgium when payment discounts are applied by correcting how taxable amounts are calculated.
key_points: Added codeunit PEPPOL30 BE Tax Info for Belgian tax amounts with payment discount
Updated the PEPPOL 3.0 Format BE enum extension alongside the new codeunit
Taxable amount is based on the total minus the payment discount percentage
Added a test codeunit covering payment discount scenarios
